page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Schola-stic. do-rò de Scholásticis ac Pontificiis doctoribus dicemus? eófne etiam stultitiæ infimulare au-ctorũ indebimus, qui sapientes, qui doctores ac soli scitia.Ecclesiæ magistri haberi volunt? Nempe nos homunciones magni illi viri cótracto supercilio, e summis suis cathedris despicient. Quare prodeat in medium Dauid præstantissimus ille Ecclesiæ doctor, ut eorum fastum & arrogantia retundat, eorúmq; coarguat ignorantiam quæ quidem eo maior est quòd eam non intelligat: adeóque bis sunt ignari qui nesciant se nescire. Cùm enim doctrinam de gratuita peccatorum remissione sapientiam atque intelligentiam vocet, cedò, quo nomine eos appellabit qui peccata non gratuito remittenda, sed humanis meritis & satisfactionibus expianda esse tradiderunt? Quare faccessat vana illa Pontificiorum doctorum ignorantia, ac potius amplectamur summam hac scientiam quā vates vel potius sacer Dei spiritus nobis proponit: Erudiam te, inquit, intelligentem te præstabo, docebo te viam quam sis ingressurus.

An etiam aliquid respondendum est ad improborum hominum conuitia quibus pio-Solifiderum simplicitatem & patientiam exagitant?ô lessapi-vos, inquiunt, omnium stultissimos, qui reli-fntes,re & patria, spretis facultatibus & commodis, eutatisobliti cognatorum atque affinium & ad ex-mundi obteros longe profugientes infinita vitæ incom-iectioni-moda perfertis! Imo potius, ô admirandam bus.& mundo plane incognitam Dei sapietiam,

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are italic and run across lines; their continuation words (ctorũ in, fntes, eutatis, iectioni-, bus.) are placed beside the matching main lines. "fntes," and "eutatis" are doubtful readings. Long s is written as s throughout. "sapietiam" as printed (possibly a printing error for sapientiam). "lessapi-" may read "les sapi-" or "sapi-". The "ô" after "exagitant?" and the "eófne" / "rò" accents are read from a faint scan. The underlined "Quare" is printed with an underline, not transcribed as markup.
